ns2:section.sectionTitle: Ag and Envir Lit for Teachers
ns2:section.sectionText: This section is for Lake County Summer Agriculture Institute participants only (July 6th to the 9th.) Students may elect to register for 2 or 3 credit hours. You should not enroll in this section for 4 hours. Students will complete 2 projects for 2 graduate credits and 3 projects for 3 graduate credits. Students taking this course may repeat it, however, only it will only be accepted one time for the Ag Education M.S. program.
